Name: Free Tractor Delivery - Start with Free Tractor
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[center][b][size=6]Free Tractor Delivery Service
[/size][/b]
[i]Get your Tractor immediately! No gold, no iron bars, no waiting.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/url][/i][/center]
[quote]Lightweight, safe, and bug-free. You can uninstall the mod as soon as you have your service used.

Because this mod uses simple logic to discount the garage, it has zero performance impact. Got your Tractor? Feel free to uninstall the mod! You keep the building, and the future price automatically returns to normal. Make sure to trash Tractor Deed if you dont want your Free Tractor before uninstalling. If you did, it's okay, just send that to trash bin, will be all good.

Or get your second Tractor :3, up to you. [/quote]

You might like this: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41349]Horse Starter Kit - Free Horse and Flute Delivery[/url]


Are you starting a new farm and don't want to wait until you have 150,000g to get the Tractor? Do you just want a second tractor without the hassle?

[b]Free Tractor Delivery Service[/b] is a simple add-on for Pathoschild's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url] that delivers a construction deed right to your mailbox.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41173/41173-1768167551-1600655596.png[/img]
[size=4][b]How It Works
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Install this mod (and the original Tractor Mod).
[/list][list]
[*]Sleep for one night.
[/list][list]
[*]Check your [b]Mailbox[/b]. You will receive a promotional letter from "Joja Heavy Industries" containing a [b]Tractor Deed[/b] (it looks like a Joja Cola).
[/list][list]
[*][b]Hold the Deed[/b] in your hand and right-click anywhere on your farm.
[/list][list]
[*]Robin's menu will open automatically with the Tractor Garage selected.
[/list][list]
[*]Place it for [b]FREE[/b]! (0 Gold, 0 Materials, Instant Build).
[/list]
[b][color=#ffff00]After getting your first Tractor if you keep the mod, future Tractor building will be for free, or uninstall it, future Tractor building will resume normal price.[/color]


﻿[youtube]ad8IJFpuRno[/youtube]
[size=4]
Why use this mod?
[/size]
[list]
[*]Perfect for New Farmers: Start your new save file with the Tractor immediately. Skip the mid-game grind and enjoy mechanization from Day 2.
[*]Lore Friendly-ish: Delivered via a promotional campaign from a "generous" heavy industry corporation.
[*]Simple & Lightweight: No new textures or complex assets. It uses existing in-game icons to keep things clean.
[/list]
[/b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41173/41173-1768167384-2102473979.png[/img]﻿
[center]﻿[/center][line]
[size=4][b]Technical FAQ
[/b][/size]
[b]Q: Does this replace the original Tractor Mod?[/b]
A: No! This is an [b]add-on[/b]. You [b]must[/b] have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Pathoschild's Tractor Mod[/url] installed for this to work. This mod simply gives you a shortcut/cheat to build the garage instantly.
[b]
Q: Is it safe to uninstall?[/b]
A: [b]YES, 100%.[/b]
Once you have placed the Garage, the building belongs to the original Tractor Mod logic. You can delete this "Delivery Service" mod at any time, and [b]you will keep your tractor[/b].
[i](Note: If you uninstall this mod, future tractor garages will return to their normal price of 150,000g).
[/i]
[b]Q: What if I already have a Tractor?[/b]
A: That's fine! You will still receive the mail. You can use the deed to build a [b]second tractor for free[/b], or you can simply throw the deed in the trash bin.

[line]
[size=4][b]Requirements
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url] (by Pathoschild)
[/list][size=4][b]Installation
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Install the original Tractor Mod.
[*]Download this mod.
[*]Unzip the [b]TractorDelivery[/b] folder into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.
[*]Run the game!
[/list]
